description: Gemini decan 1 (May 21 to May 30): personality, love, work and growth, with Mercury as sub-ruler of the first ten degrees of Gemini.
answer: In Western astrology, the first decan of Gemini covers 0° to 9° of the sign, roughly May 21 to May 30, with Mercury as its sub-ruler, the sign's own planet. It is read as quicksilver curiosity, doubled and darting in every direction. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Gemini decan 1 personality
paragraphs: Mercury rules Gemini and also co-rules its first decan, so the opening ten degrees of the Twins are usually read as the sign at full speed. Thought, speech and movement all run quickly here. Natives are often described as bright, witty and endlessly curious, juggling several conversations, books and plans at once. They tend to learn by asking questions, and their questions can be refreshingly direct. Information is fuel; a dull afternoon can feel almost physically uncomfortable to them. Their charm lies in making the world seem more interesting simply by noticing so much of it.

The doubled Mercury influence sharpens adaptability and verbal agility, and it can also scatter attention. First-decan Geminis may start many projects and finish fewer, not from laziness but because the next idea arrives before the current one is done. Traditional sources linked this decan with writing, trade and messages, roles that reward speed and versatility. Without a contrasting sub-ruler to steady them, these natives often benefit from building simple external structures: lists, deadlines, trusted collaborators. When the mind has a channel, its sparkle becomes genuinely productive rather than merely restless. Their range is the gift; focus is the craft. Few people make a commute more entertaining.

sections.heading: Gemini decan 1 in love and at work
paragraphs: First-decan Geminis tend to fall for minds before anything else. Banter, shared jokes and long conversations about everything and nothing are central to attraction. They often need a partner who can keep up, change subjects without fuss and tolerate a busy social calendar. Emotional depth may come more slowly, as they sometimes talk about feelings rather than sit with them. Variety in dates and routines helps keep the spark alive. A partner who offers both stimulation and a calm place to land often earns their lasting devotion.

At work this decan shines in fast-moving environments where communication is central. Journalism, marketing, sales, teaching, social media, translation and coordination roles often fit well. They are quick learners who can pick up a new tool or topic remarkably fast. Repetitive tasks and long stretches of silence can drain them, so variety in the working week matters. Their challenge is depth: sticking with one area long enough to become truly expert. Short sprints with clear finish lines tend to suit their energy better than vague, open-ended projects.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Gemini decan 1: what Mercury adds
paragraphs: The first decan covers 0° to 9° of Gemini, which in most years means birthdays from May 21 to May 30. First decans take the sign's own ruler, so Mercury rules both the sign and this decan, which is why it is often called the purest expression of Gemini. The other two decans of Gemini belong to Venus (decan 2) and Uranus (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Mercury lends curiosity, quick wits and a talent for language and detail. Under its influence a sign is said to think aloud, question more, trade information freely and enjoy problems that reward cleverness more than force. Mercurial decans are often linked with writing, trade, teaching and nimble problem-solving, and their usual lesson is to finish what the quick mind starts. Here Mercury doubles up with the sign's own ruler, so Gemini's curiosity, wit, adaptability and a quick, talkative mind come through with little filtering.

sections.heading: Growth for Gemini decan 1
paragraphs: For first-decan Geminis, growth often comes through focus and presence. Try choosing one project each month to see through completely, however many others beckon. Practise listening to a friend without planning the next reply, and notice what changes. Writing by hand or walking without a phone can quiet a busy mind. When a feeling surfaces, consider naming it plainly instead of analysing it immediately. Curiosity remains a superpower, and it becomes even more useful when paired with the patience to follow one thread all the way.

Within Gemini, decan 2 leans towards airy wit softened by venusian charm and social grace and decan 3 leans towards inventive, independent thinking that leaps ahead of its time. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: What makes the first decan of Gemini so quick-witted?
faq.answer: In the first decan Mercury is both the sign ruler and the sub-ruler, so its themes of speed, communication and curiosity are concentrated. Astrologers often describe these Geminis as the sign's sharpest talkers and fastest learners, though they may need structure to channel their many interests.

faq.question: What are the dates of Gemini decan 1?
faq.answer: In most years May 21 to May 30, the days when the Sun is between 0° and 9° of Gemini. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Gemini decan 1?
faq.answer: Mercury. In the triplicity system each air sign's decans take the rulers of the air signs in order, starting with Gemini's own ruler, Mercury.
